Ll.bar_b_note: A murky brown-green forest with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings, a player creature you can barely find and a HUD that fills the left and bottom of every frame sank it; the gold-and-black Voltarach is the only thing carrying it.

Fv.bar_b_note: The warm, appealing face with soft hair and beard and the earthy green and brown costume sit at Palworld-class character finish, though the empty grey stage shows nothing of Valheim-style light.

Yi.bar_b_note: A reads as a glossy terracotta piggy-bank toy with stuck-on moss decals, and B's naturalistic fur is undercut by a body that floats off the ground in the faint poses and is barely taller than the trainer.

Ji.bar_b_note: The strong black-and-gold coat and hat silhouette carry it, but the flat, low-detail face with dot eyes and the plain lighting fall short of Palworld finish.

Zx.bar_b_note: The warm, appealing face with soft hair and beard and the earthy green and brown costume sit at Palworld-class character finish, though the empty grey stage shows nothing of Valheim-style light.

Ml.bar_b_note: Smeared low-res ground, sparse and even grass, clumped identical tree walls and a flat, pale, shadowless-sky grade read as an early prototype beside Palworld's lush fields, even where the aftermath props tell a story.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fights: add camera collision with fade-out for foliage and trunks, replace the flat magenta telegraph rings with real-object VFX (lightning, sparks, debris) and an impact, give the arena the purple storm sky and rim light, and slim the HUD so the player's creature and the boss are readable.

Meadows grade and density: sharper ground materials, grass clustered into groves and clearings instead of an even carpet, varied tree scale, warm sun with cool blue distance, and aftermath frames that always strike the enemy banner and leave site-specific debris.

Bring every creature up to the owner's naturalistic bar (e.g. replace the clay-toy boar with a furred, taller model that stays grounded in its faint poses) and give lower-tier villagers like Ji properly modelled faces and eyes.
